# coded-pir-mlwe-complexity-lab

> Zero-Mathlib Lean 4.35.0 formal proofs (19 theorems `T1a`–`T3f` across 6 kernels), C11/Python/Eshkol multi-language verifiers, an interactive GitHub Pages Proof Blueprint, and a 14-page AMS-LaTeX preprint (`v2.0.0`) on Coded/Byzantine PIR (`CS-053`), Module-LWE reduction tightness & `Dyadic-256` (`CS-026`/`QC-042`/`CM-048`), and Koszul tensor / complexity-theoretic barriers (`CS-001`/`CS-004`/`CS-010`/`CS-012`/`CS-051`).

- Author: Alexander S. Donahue (Independent Researcher, Spokane, WA, USA; ORCID 0009-0006-8168-9648)
- Code License: Apache-2.0 | Docs & Paper License: CC-BY-4.0
- Interactive Proof Blueprint: https://0thernes.github.io/coded-pir-mlwe-complexity-lab/

## Primary Documentation
- [README.md](README.md): Project overview, 19 headline theorems (`T1a`–`T3f`), verbatim 21-declaration Lean axiom audit, and quickstart.
- [CLAIMS.md](CLAIMS.md): Claim-by-claim ledger (`C1`–`C19`), open frontiers (`O1`–`O5`), and falsification protocol.
- [LIMITATIONS.md](LIMITATIONS.md): Explicit non-claims, formal vs. computational boundaries, and real-vs-metaphor breakdown.
- [REPLICATION.md](REPLICATION.md): Clean-room replication commands and verification log.
- [HARDENING_LOG.md](HARDENING_LOG.md): 15 real defects/holes found and resolved across audit passes.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Canonical instructions for AI coding agents.

## Technical Artifacts
- [lean/Solution.lean](lean/Solution.lean): Master zero-Mathlib Lean 4.35.0 solution (`T1a`–`T3f`).
- [lean/TriadFrontier/KoszulTensor.lean](lean/TriadFrontier/KoszulTensor.lean): Field-universal Koszul flattening tensor rank bridge (`T3e`).
- [lean/VerifyAxioms.lean](lean/VerifyAxioms.lean): Strict `#print axioms` audit script (21 declarations).
- [lean/formalization.yaml](lean/formalization.yaml): Machine-readable formalization registry metadata.
- [docs/site/blueprint.html](docs/site/blueprint.html): Interactive 19-theorem Proof Blueprint DAG.
- [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md): System and mathematical dependency architecture.
- [docs/statement-fidelity.md](docs/statement-fidelity.md): Line-by-line Lean-to-paper statement fidelity table.
- [dist/Donahue_2026_coded_pir_mlwe_complexity_frontier.pdf](dist/Donahue_2026_coded_pir_mlwe_complexity_frontier.pdf): Frozen 14-page AMS-LaTeX preprint (`v2.0.0`).
